items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-08-31
items.q: There's a friend of mine, Ralph Collins

ctx.x: I don't know. It's something about the city. It's something about the music maybe that makes them better people. There's a friend of mine, Ralph Collins, always had that theory too. He said he wanted to really test it when he got to New Orleans. He figured a good guy is going to be a good musician. The good musicians are good guys and that's, it's almost always that way. They're not perfect either. Everybody has plenty of faults, but I mean they're not small people or crooks or all that. I mean they're, they're…
Most of them, a lot of them have always been very friendly.
